blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Human mesh recovery (HMR) provides a geometric foundation for understanding human motion, but accurately reconstructing both body motion and fine hand articulation from videos remains challenging, especially in real-world scenes where occlusion and partial visibility are common. Video generation pretraining offers rich spatial and temporal priors for this task, but its focus on visual synthesis leaves a gap between these representations and explicit human geometry. We present DreamHMR, a general framework that adapts video generation priors for complete body-and-hand reconstruction. It follows a global-to-local strategy, first grounding video representations in human geometry and then refining body and hand detail with reliable local evidence. Global Body Representation Transfer trains the video backbone to predict complete human renderings, turning its native prediction task into a means of learning surface correspondence and posed geometry. Local Joint Feature Enhancement combines contextual estimates with reliable local evidence to recover fine body and hand detail, while limiting interference from occluders and background. Experiments on five datasets with four video backbones demonstrate strong reconstruction performance across backbone families. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our best model outperforms the best existing methods on all reported metrics of 3DPW, EMDB-1, and RICH, reducing body MPJPE by 4.2%, 4.7%, and 6.1%, respectively. In more challenging occlusion settings on held-out BEDLAM and EgoBody sequences, DreamHMR reduces overall body and hand MPJPE by 7.0% and 10.0%, respectively. Our code will be made publicly available.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Human mesh recovery (HMR) reconstructs the 3D human body from visual observations, providing a geometric foundation for understanding and modeling human motion.
Its estimates support a wide range of downstream applications, from structured motion analysis for action recognition ( Goel et al., 2023 ) to motion references for humanoid robot teleoperation and imitation learning ( He et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) .
The field has advanced rapidly, with progress in monocular parametric body estimation ( Kanazawa et al., 2018 ; Kolotouros et al., 2019 ) , temporal modeling from video ( Kocabas et al., 2020 ) , and large-scale learning from diverse imagery ( Goel et al., 2023 ) .
Despite these advances, recovering complete body and hand motion from real-world videos remains challenging, as occlusion and partial visibility leave incomplete and uneven visual evidence across body parts and frames.
blocks.zh:
人网恢复(HMR)从视觉观察中重建出3D人体,为理解和模拟人类运动提供了几何基础.
其估计支持了广泛的下游应用,从结构运动分析用于行动识别(Goel等,2023年)到人类类机器人远程操作和仿真学习的运动参考(He等,2024年;Fu等,2025年;赵等,2025年;罗等,2026年).
球场进展迅速,单相参数体估计有所进展(Kanazawa等,2018;Kolotouros等,2019;从视频中测出时间模型(Kocabas等,2020;)),并大规模地从多相图象中学习(Goel等,2023.
尽管取得了这些进步,但从真实世界的视频中恢复完整的身体和手动仍然具有挑战性,因为隔离和部分能见度使身体各部分和框架的视觉证据不完整和不均衡。

blocks.en:
Recovering motion from such observations requires both inferring missing structure and identifying reliable local evidence.
Information from visible body parts and neighboring frames can help constrain unobserved body and hand configurations.
However, local features sampled near a joint may correspond to an occluder or the background rather than the target person, so incorporating them indiscriminately can introduce misleading cues.
A reconstruction model therefore needs to combine contextual inference of the complete body with selective use of local observations for detailed body and hand recovery.
blocks.zh:
从这种观察中恢复运动既需要推断缺失的结构,也需要查明可靠的当地证据。
来自可见身体部位和相邻相框的信息可以帮助约束未被观察的身体和手的配置.
然而,在关节附近取样的地物可能与占地者或背景相对应,而不是与目标人相对应,因此不加区别地纳入这些地物可能会引入误导提示.
因此,重建模式需要结合整个身体的背景推论,有选择地利用当地观察来进行详细的身体和手部恢复。

blocks.en:
Video generation pretraining offers a promising starting point for learning such contextual representations ( Team Wan and others, 2025 ) .
By learning to synthesize videos, these models capture spatial appearance and temporal dependencies within a shared representation, offering potentially useful cues for reasoning about body and hand motion under partial observations.
However, their training objective targets visual synthesis rather than explicit human pose and surface geometry.
Transferring these representations to human reconstruction therefore requires adapting them to the underlying structure of the human body.
blocks.zh:
视频生成预训为学习这种背景表现提供了一个有希望的起点(Team Wan等,2025年)。
这些模型通过学习合成视频,在共享的表示中捕捉空间外观和时间依赖性,为在部分观察下对身体和手动进行推理提供了潜在的有用提示.
然而,他们的训练目标是视觉合成,而不是明显的人相和地表几何.
因此,将这些表述转移给人类重建需要使其适应人体的基本结构。

blocks.en:
To this end, we present DreamHMR, a framework that adapts video generation representations for complete body-and-hand reconstruction through geometric supervision and evidence-gated local refinement.
First, Global Body Representation Transfer trains the video backbone to predict renderings of complete SMPL-X bodies ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ) , turning its video prediction objective into a proxy for learning human structure.
Canonical surface colors encode correspondence across poses, while shading conveys pose-dependent geometry, providing supervision for body regions even when they are absent from the observations.
Second, Local Joint Feature Enhancement refines contextual body and hand estimates using features sampled around predicted joints.
Supervised evidence scores predict target-person support at these locations and weight the local updates, limiting the influence of features drawn from occluders or background.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提出DreamHMR,这个框架通过几何监督以及以证据为主的局部改进,使视频生成表达方式适应完整的身体和手部重建.
第一,Global Body Dignation Transfer培训视频骨干,预测完整的SMPL-X天体的渲染(Pavlakos等,2019年),将视频预测目标转化为学习人文结构的代名词.
光圈表面的颜色编码了各姿势之间的通信,而阴影则传达了形而上学的几何特征,即使身体区域没有被观测到,也要对其进行监督。
第二,地方联合地物增强利用在预测关节周围取样的地物来改进上下文体和手势估计。
被监督的证据分数预测了这些地点的目标人支持,并量了当地更新,限制了从占卜者或背景所取出特征的影响.

blocks.en:
Experiments spanning five datasets and four video backbones demonstrate strong reconstruction performance, with gains extending across backbone families.
On standard benchmarks, our Wan-5B model outperforms the best existing methods across all reported metrics under a unified evaluation protocol, reducing body MPJPE by 4.2%, 4.7%, and 6.1% on 3DPW, EMDB-1, and RICH, respectively.
In challenging occlusion settings on held-out BEDLAM and EgoBody sequences, it reduces overall body and hand MPJPE by 7.0% and 10.0%, respectively.
blocks.zh:
跨越5个数据集和4个视频主干线的实验显示重建表现强劲,收益扩展到了骨干家庭。
在标准基准上,我们的Wan-5B模型在统一评价协议下,超越了所有报告指标的现有最佳方法,在3DPW、EMDB-1和RICH上,MPJPE的机体分别减少了4.2%、4.7%和6.1%。
在对被搁置的BEDLAM和EgoBody序列的隔离设置提出质疑时,它将整体体和手分别减少7.0%和10.0%。

blocks.en: DreamHMR makes the following contributions: • We bring pretrained video generation priors to complete body-and-hand reconstruction through Global Body Representation Transfer , offering a new approach to recovering human motion from occluded and incomplete observations. • We introduce Local Joint Feature Enhancement to recover fine body and hand detail from reliable local evidence, complementing global reconstruction within a general framework applicable across different video backbones. • Extensive experiments on five datasets and four video backbones demonstrate that DreamHMR outperforms the best existing methods on standard HMR benchmarks, with body and hand MPJPE reduced by 7.0% and 10.0%, respectively, in challenging occlusion settings.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Human mesh recovery estimates parametric bodies from images ( Kanazawa et al., 2018 ; Kolotouros et al., 2019 ) , with video models adding temporal context ( Kocabas et al., 2020 ; Goel et al., 2023 ) . PromptHMR-Vid combines full-image features with a box-prompted temporal transformer ( Wang et al., 2025 ) ; GENMO learns a motion distribution for generation and estimation ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Whole-body methods recover articulated bodies and hands ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ; Lin et al., 2023b ; Li et al., 2023 ; Baradel et al., 2024 ; Moon, 2026 ) , scale training data and model capacity ( Cai et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) ; dedicated models recover detailed hand meshes ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ; Potamias et al., 2025 ) . DreamHMR uses a shared video generation representation for body-and-hand recovery.

FournalHMR-Vid结合了全成像特征和箱快活时间变压器(Wang等,2025年;GENMO学习了运动分布来生成和估计(Li等,2025年). 全体方法可收复被收复的躯体和手(Pavlakos等,2019;Lin等,2023b;Li等,2023;Baradel等,2024;Moon等,2026),规模培训数据和模型容量. blocks.en: Image diffusion features support correspondence estimation ( Tang et al., 2023 ; Stracke et al., 2025 ) , while video diffusion features support motion and geometry tasks ( Vélez et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . DPMesh conditions a text-to-image diffusion backbone on 2D observations for occluded mesh recovery ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) , and ADHMR optimizes diffusion-based mesh predictions with preference data ( Shen et al., 2025 ) . DreamHMR adapts video generation features with complete human renderings to encode surface correspondence and posed geometry for body-and-hand recovery.
blocks.zh: 图像传播特征支持函证估计(Tang等,2023;Strake等,2025;而视频传播特征支持运动和几何任务(Vélez等,2025;Nam等,2025;Huang等,2026). DPMesh在2D观测上以文字到图像的传播为主干线,用于occided mesh的恢复(Zhu等,2024年),而ADHMR则以偏好数据优化了基于传播的网络预测(Shen等,2025年). DreamHMR将带完整人造渲染的视频生成功能来编码地表通信,并构成身体和手部恢复的几何.

blocks.en: Occluded HMR addresses body reconstruction with incomplete observations ( Khirodkar et al., 2022 ) . PARE aggregates neighboring regions with part-guided attention ( Kocabas et al., 2021 ) , and Divide and Fuse merges part meshes from partially visible images ( Luan et al., 2024 ) . Human and joint tokens structure decoding ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , while local image-aligned features refine hands ( Potamias et al., 2025 ) . Nearby features may describe background or another person; DreamHMR learns evidence scores under supervision to weight their updates.

blocks.en: We render a canonical surface map ( Kulkarni et al., 2019 ) : every visible pixel is colored by the canonical surface coordinates of its corresponding template point (Figure 2 ). The image-space encoding of these coordinates follows dense human pose estimation ( Güler et al., 2018 ) . Let 𝐓 i \mathbf{T}_{i} be vertex i i of a neutral SMPL-X mesh in its template pose, with per-axis extrema 𝐓 min \mathbf{T}_{\min} and 𝐓 max \mathbf{T}_{\max} . We normalize these template coordinates componentwise to obtain the R, G, and B channels: 𝐂 i = 𝐓 i − 𝐓 min 𝐓 max − 𝐓 min ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] 3 . \mathbf{C}_{i}=\frac{\mathbf{T}_{i}-\mathbf{T}_{\min}}{\mathbf{T}_{\max}-\mathbf{T}_{\min}}\in[0,1]^{3}. (2) The canonical surface map is computed once: vertex i i retains 𝐂 i \mathbf{C}_{i} as pose and shape deform the mesh. The rendered color therefore identifies the same body surface location across poses, people, and frames, supplying dense correspondence supervision. blocks.en: DreamHMR uses cross-frame RGB context to improve reconstruction. Table 5 evaluates the full-budget Wan-1.3B checkpoint at the same center frames after replacing every RGB frame and observation mask with the center-frame input. This intervention increases body/hand MPJPE by 12.71/9.27 mm under occlusion, compared with 3.26/3.58 mm without additional masking. The larger effect under occlusion supports the use of neighboring observations for reconstruction. This diagnostic measures the response to an inference-time change in temporal context and input distribution. The original tracks and timestamps are retained in both conditions, so the repeated sequence removes changing RGB evidence while preserving the tracking input. We score only the center frame to keep the evaluation target fixed across conditions; these errors therefore should not be compared directly with the full-window averages in the other ablations. Appendix Figure 6 shows reconstructions through successive phases of a real action.
blocks.zh: DreamHMR使用跨框架RGB上下文来改进重建. 表5评价同一中心框架的全预算Wan-1.3B检查点,然后用中心框架输入替换出每个RGB帧和观察口罩. 这种干预使被封禁下的身体/手部MPJPE增加12.71/9.27毫米,而3.26/3.58毫米没有增加口罩. 被隔离下的较大影响支持了利用相邻观测进行重建. 这种诊断测量对时间背景和输入分布的推断时间变化的反应。 原来的音轨和时间戳在两种条件下都保留了下来,因此重复的序列在保留跟踪输入的同时会去除正在改变的RGB证据. 我们只得一个中心框架,以在各种条件下固定评价目标;因此,这些错误不应直接同其他堆积物中的全部窗口平均数相提并论。 附录图6显示经过实际行动的相继阶段的重建情况。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: DreamHMR adapts video generation representations for complete body-and-hand recovery under occlusion. Complete human renderings transfer surface correspondence and posed geometry into the backbone, while evidence-gated local features refine contextual body-part estimates. Across four video backbones, DreamHMR improves reconstruction under occlusion and attains the lowest errors on the evaluated HMR benchmarks.
blocks.zh: DreamHMR调整了视频生成表达方式,以在被隔离下实现完整的身体和手恢复. 完整的人体渲染能转移地表相通并给骨干提供几何特征,而由证据提出的局部特征则能完善上下文的体段估计. DreamHMR在四个视频主干线上改进了被隔离的重建,并实现了经评价的HMR基准上的最低误差.

blocks.en: A frozen HumanArt YOLOX-X detector with ByteTrack provides the target tracks from each observed RGB sequence. The presence label is positive when the observation region contains at least 32 visible target-person pixels. A joint receives a positive evidence label when its ground-truth projection lies in both the observation region and the target’s visible instance mask. Evidence supervision uses frames with reliable, aligned visible-instance masks; other samples contribute their available geometric and 2D labels. Complete body-and-hand geometry remains supervised wherever the corresponding annotations are available.
blocks.zh: 带有"字节追踪"的被冻结的"人类艺术"(HumanArt YOLOX-X)探测器提供了从每个被观测到的RGB序列中获取的目标轨迹. 当观测区域包含至少32个可见的目标人像素时,存在标签为正. 当地面真实投影既位于观测区,又位于目标可见的外表上时,联合体会得到正面证据标签。 证据监督使用装有可靠、对齐的可见膜;其他样本提供了可用的几何和二维标签。 只要有相应的说明,完整的体相和手相几何仍然受到监督。

blocks.en: The occlusion evaluation and ablation holdouts each contain 90 BEDLAM and 30 EgoBody source sequences. Each sequence supplies two source windows; each window yields one full, eight static, and eight dynamic observations, giving 4,080 windows per holdout. The two holdouts are disjoint from each other, training, and validation, with identities, recording sessions, source motions, and scenes separated across splits. EgoBody examples use third-person videos with body-and-hand annotations. Evaluation on widely used benchmarks uses the official 3DPW test, EMDB-1, and RICH test sets with their original RGB inputs.
blocks.zh: 封存评估和封存各包含90个BEDLAM和30个EgoBody源序列. 每个序列提供2个源窗口;每个窗口产生1个全,8个静态和8个动态观测,每个被搁置的窗口给出4,080个. 两个阻隔者相互脱节,训练,验证,身份,录音会话,源动,场景相隔. EgoBody的例子使用第三人称视频,并有身体和手的注释. 对被广泛使用的基准的评价使用官方的3DPW测试,EMDB-1和RICH测试集,并附有其原始的RGB输入.

blocks.en: All compared methods receive the same observed RGB and target tracks. Video methods process complete windows; image methods process per-frame crops from the shared tracks. We use released inference models without test-time flipping or additional temporal smoothing. SMPLest-X uses the official H40 weights, and 3DB-DINOv3 includes its released hand decoder. Public body evaluation uses 14/24/24 joints for 3DPW/EMDB-1/RICH, respectively, with common joint regressors and frozen topology mappings for SMPL-X, MHR, and SMPL-X/MANO predictions. MPJPE and PVE use pelvis alignment; PA-MPJPE additionally fits a similarity transform. Under occlusion, body MPJPE uses 21 non-root joints relative to the pelvis; hand MPJPE uses 15 joints per hand relative to the wrist, with equal left/right weighting.
blocks.zh: 所有比较方法都得到相同的被观测到的RGB和目标轨迹. 视频方法处理完整的窗口;图像方法从共享的音轨处理每帧收成. 我们使用释放的推论模型,没有测试时间翻转或额外的时间平滑. SMPLest-X使用正式的H40重,而3DB-DINOv3包括了它的已放出手的解码器. 公共机构评价对3DPW/EMDB-1/RICH分别采用14/24联想,对SMPL-X,MHR和SMPL-X/MANO的预测采用常见的联想后退和冷冻地理学绘图. MPJPE和PVE使用骨盆对齐;PA-MPJPE额外适合类似变相. 在被隔离下,身体MPJPE相对骨盆使用21个非根关节;手MPJPE相对腕部使用每只手用15个关节,平分左/右重.

blocks.en: For long videos, DreamHMR centers its 81-frame windows at frames 0 , 40 , 80 , … 0,40,80,\ldots and the final frame, replicating boundary frames where necessary. Each real frame takes the prediction from its nearest window center, with ties assigned to the earlier center. Public benchmark results average sequences equally. For occlusion evaluation, errors are averaged within each source sequence, then equally across sequences within each dataset; BEDLAM and EgoBody contribute 75% and 25%, respectively, and static/dynamic conditions contribute equally. The temporal-context diagnostic evaluates only the center frame: repeated inputs duplicate its RGB and observation mask while retaining the original tracks and timestamps.

blocks.en: This appendix expands the renderer summarized by Equation 2 . For every annotated frame, it converts SMPL-X pose and shape parameters into one RGB image of a complete, camera-aligned human. The same procedure is applied to all frames to form the supervision video I rend 1 : T I^{\rm rend}_{1:T} . blocks.en: Video generation pretraining provides a useful initialization for reconstruction under a fixed task-training budget. Table 9 compares pretrained and randomly initialized DiTs within the same Wan architecture after 10,000 task-training steps, with all 81 frames evaluated. The paired runs share task data, the structured readout, evidence gating, and optimization settings; the corresponding pretrained VAE and text encoder are retained in both runs. Pretrained initialization reduces body/hand MPJPE under occlusion by 13.53/8.28 mm at 1.3B and 15.35/12.97 mm at 5B.

blocks.en: DINOv3-H+ ( Simeoni and others, 2025 ) provides a complementary image self-supervised representation reference under the same task-training settings. This comparison evaluates the two representation choices, which differ in architecture, pretraining, and temporal encoding.
